name: dsh-information-environment-governance
description: Information Environment Governance (IEG): an additive project-work governance layer for DeepSeek Harness. Contributes one system-prompt section and uses deterministic runtime seams (agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, tools.guard) for enforcement, plus the `dsh-ieg` terminal interface for control (start/pause/restart/exit), prompt.md editing and the npm lifecycle. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const need=['lib/index.js','bin/ieg','lib/kernel/export.js','lib/kernel/prompt-compiler.js','lib/kernel/prompt-override.js','lib/kernel/control.js','lib/kernel/prompt-store.js','lib/kernel/lifecycle.js','lib/bin/ieg.js','cordis.patch.yml','LICENSE','CHANGELOG.md','README.md'];for(const f of need)fs.accessSync(f);console.log('ieg pack: required artifacts present')"
